description: A free, public index of agent-friendly web endpoints — and the methods for building them.
machine_surfaces: Every page is triple-rendered: human HTML, a .json twin, and a .md markdown twin. llms.txt summarizes the site for language models; llms-full.txt carries the complete text; search.json powers client-side search.

deployment.discovery_note: Project-path deployment on GitHub Pages: the discovery document lives under the project prefix, not the origin root. A root deployment serves it at /.well-known/wellknownindex.json per RFC 8615.

license_note: Free public commons. No ads, no tracking.
